But if I'm not sure, taking something without asking could be seen as disrespectful. Next, why did I take the sweater? It was to get it dry-cleaned, which seems like a good intention. I probably wanted to help my friend by keeping their clothes looking nice. But still, I should have asked first. I should think about the concept of consent. Did my friend give me permission to take their sweater? If not, then taking it without asking might be wrong. Even if the intention was good, the action itself could be seen as intrusive.
